items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: I don't know anything much about him, playing around here, but that's before my time.

ctx.x: Would you say was there any special loudness or anything?

No. Just ordinary loud trumpet players. You all have to get anything on the old man Petit? Not much. Not much. Not much. I don't see how you all did. I don't know anything much about him, playing around here, but that's before my time. But when I was playing, he was still living though.
Bill knew him, you know. I knew him too.
